crossRefs.note: “ ‘You shall not curse the deaf, nor put a stumbling block before the blind; but you shall fear your God. I am Yahweh.
Bathsheba therefore went to king Solomon, to speak to him for Adonijah. The king rose up to meet her, and bowed himself…
Now Elihu had waited to speak to Job, because they were elder than he.
Elihu the son of Barachel the Buzite answered, “I am young, and you are very old; Therefore I held back, and didn’t…
Gray hair is a crown of glory. It is attained by a life of righteousness.
The glory of young men is their strength. The splendor of old men is their gray hair.
The people will be oppressed, everyone by another, and everyone by his neighbor. The child will behave himself proudly…
Princes were hanged up by their hands. The faces of elders were not honored.
Therefore give everyone what you owe: if you owe taxes, pay taxes; if customs, then customs; if respect, then respect…
Don’t rebuke an older man, but exhort him as a father; the younger men as brothers;
Honor all men. Love the brotherhood. Fear God. Honor the king.

translations.web: “ ‘You shall rise up before the gray head and honor the face of the elderly; and you shall fear your God. I am Yahweh.
translations.bsb: You are to rise in the presence of the elderly, honor the aged, and fear your God. I am the LORD.
translations.kjv: Thou shalt rise up before the hoary head, and honour the face of the old man, and fear thy God: I am the LORD.
translations.asv: Thou shalt rise up before the hoary head, and honor the face of the old man, and thou shalt fear thy God: I am Jehovah.
